firm_data.firm_description: Stulberg & Walsh, LLP is a New York-based law firm dedicated to providing expert counsel and representation to individual employees and classes of employees, public- and private-sector labor unions, employee benefit plans, and disability rights organizations. Founded in 1985, the firm offers experience in all aspects of workplace and disability rights law.
notable_facts: The firm was formerly known as Broach & Stulberg, LLP.
They represent clients in the United States and abroad.
They have experience in negotiation and drafting of employment agreements.

email.subject: AI for Stulberg & Walsh, LLP: built for labor and employment firms
email.body:
Hi Robert,

Stulberg & Walsh has built something rare in labor and employment law: deep expertise across employee representation, unions, and disability rights since 1985. That scope demands tools that actually understand workplace complexity, not generic document automation.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on employment matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
